tips.title: Tips
tips.files: Attach files with the paperclip: the model reads them along with your question.
tips.skills: Type <kbd>$</kbd> to use a skill, saved instructions for tasks you repeat. <kbd>/skill</kbd> saves what you just did as a new one.
tips.projects: Group chats into projects from the sidebar. A project's instructions apply to all its chats.
